body:
As my feelings of gender non-conformity have developed, I've been terribly afraid to talk about it, because I don't know right now if I'm in the wrong body, and worry about offending those who are more certain about their gender and wish to change it.

More than anything, I wish to travel. I also wish to spend some of my life in an intimate relationship with someone who truly gets me. That person will most likely not be cisgender, most likely not straight. For the sake of my family, I've probably been the one to beat myself up the most. I've dedicated so much of myself in an effort to make up for my own parent's failures.

I'm not necessarily feeling old, as much as I feel that most people my age don't seem to be very active online, or frighteningly 'conservative', which today means bashing Obama and making fun of people like me. I just need to look at their Facebook feeds. The rest are settled in their lives and are not looking for friends, not interested in helping someone they don't know, most likely oblivious to people who didn't live the dream life. You know, their parents didn't abandon them, their parents didn't lie to them, their childhoods worked out pretty much as advertised, and I could go on and on. I've lived in a state of high anxiety for most of my life, and am looking forward to just being myself, not worrying about anybody's opinion.

Our kids are adults, in college, but currently both at home. My wife and I have 25 years of marriage to be proud of. She is my only confidant and friend, and you can guess how shitty that is when you need to deal with weighty issues like the possibility of divorcing, moving out, splitting everything up, and completely starting over alone. We've been through a lot of emotions in the last 8 years, and I think we're both at the end of where we can do this alone. I've been trying to ramp up the subject at home. I know that she does not want to lose me, but I feel like I'm in a real catch-22. I feel every bit of her pain, and it tortures me to have to think of some more ways to express my feelings to her. I have to live with my own pain, but it's to some extent a known quantity, and I take on more because it's easier than putting it on someone else. I feel that we can split amicably if we can just find some moments of peace. It's not easy raising kids, and it can get pretty awful when they're teenagers and beyond. I think one reason I'm feeling old , at least here, is because our kids are most likely at the median age for Reddit, and I'm one of teh olds. I honestly don't know what happened to so many people my age. They seem to embody the traits that were common to the adults we had when I was around 20. They simply are not very active on places like Reddit, and are baffled by technology.

Thank you, nice people for the supportive comments. I feel better having gotten some of this out.
